offer.text: My child wandered off and hasn't come home. Please — search the wilds for any sign of them. Start with the forest where they liked to play.

accept.text: Thank you. Bring word the moment you find anything.

decline.text: Please... if you change your mind, I'll be here, waiting.

in_progress.text: Any trace of my little one out there?

ready.text: You searched the forest? Tell me everything.

complete.text: Bless you for looking. At least now I know someone cared enough to try.
